caption: The drawing depicts a triangular metallic object composed of three cylindrical containers placed on a flat triangular tray. Each corner of the tray is supported by a foot shaped like a lion's head and paw. The left container appears to have a smooth lid, the rightmost one is slightly smaller with a lid as well, and the central front container has a perforated lid, possibly for sprinkling or dispensing. At the back center of the tray, there is a vertical ring handle for lifting the entire object. The overall color is silver with blue-gray shading and white highlights, suggesting a polished, reflective metallic surface. The drawing is outlined with a rectangular border, and there is an ornate family crest or emblem with a bird in profile within an ornamental frame in the top right corner. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Silver Holder
